activities.title: stories C1 context 0454
activities.content: A researcher received an anonymous document that seemed to support a striking allegation against a local official. The accompanying email urged immediate publication, claiming delay would make the information worthless. Rather than amplify the claim, the researcher compared the document with public records, sought independent confirmation and discovered several inconsistencies in the dates. In her report she described what could be verified, what remained unresolved and why the allegation should not be treated as established fact.

activities.explanation: Her response separates confirmed facts from an unverified accusation.
activities.option_b: she published the accusation as proven
